descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94700 AC 5 · “No API keys, model pickers, dictation engine choice, bulk delete, or demo-data options appear anywhere in the app”.

Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S03 Main screens in both modes (charts, Add, Tasks, Handoffs, Settings, template form): no API-key field, key string, model picker or engine choice

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 No API key fields, model pickers or dictation engine choice appear anywhere in the app, in Hospital and Nursing Home. This is the OAT-05 part of the AC; bulk delete and demo data are TC-24 scope. (TFA-94700 AC 5)
  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And … (UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1'); TFA-94423 AC 1)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local stack, fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, signed-in @roundai.test physician who has already accepted consent

When The agent visits the Hospital chart, Add Patient, Tasks, the Handoffs inbox, Settings and the New template form, then the Nursing Home chart, Add Resident, Tasks and Settings opened from Nursing Home. It changes, generates, saves and deletes nothing.

Then No visited screen shows an API key field or label, a key-shaped string, a model or vendor name or picker, a Test Connection button or a dictation engine choice. This holds in both modes. Screens not visited (patient detail sub-sheets, Dashboard) are not claimed.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint (case-insensitive). Every checkpoint mustNotContain 'API key', 'AKIA', 'sk-proj', 'BEGIN PRIVATE KEY', 'private_key', 'Test Connection', the model and vendor names a picker would show ('Haiku', 'Mistral', 'Gemini', 'Whisper', 'OpenAI', 'GPT-', 'Claude', 'Deepgram', 'Bedrock', 'Vertex'; TFA-94700 removed 'API keys (all providers); …

Where it ran: dev unit U24; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S03

Main screens in both modes (charts, Add, Tasks, Handoffs, Settings, template form): no API-key field, key string, model picker or engine choice

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U24.rejudged.verdict.json), unit U24 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 100 turns, 227 s, $0.60.

Plan: unit U24 (#24, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Screen tour: forms, settings, Ask sheets. Same legacy seed, read-only screen tour. OAT-05 S03 already opens Add Resident and the chart tabs; TC-03 S11 (Add Resident fields) and TC-15 S13 (Ask sheets open from Encounter and Post-Round, no question) look at the same screens. Nothing is saved. Runs together with TC-03/S11, TC-15/S13.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #24, U24; checked: yes): Fail (known) after re-judge — OAT-05 S03 first failed only on a 'Facility' anchor (field not built) — case fixed, saved evidence re-judged: no key/vendor/model/engine text on any visited screen (Pass). TC-03 S11: no Facility on the NH Add form (known, TFA-92581 AC 3 / C1). TC-15 S13: Ask AI reachable on Encounter + Post-Round (Pass)
